The '''Battle of Soremaine''' is the site of one of the major battles of the [[Whitecloak War]]. 

== Major events ==
Under the command of [[Pedron Niall]], the [[Whitecloaks]] manage to capture [[Mattin Stepaneos]] who is later ransomed. If not for the [[Illianer Companions]], the Illianer army would have been routed.
